content: 4:1-15 Munon gugum Qenu Igomurur wuriboopuriminer eng wuri ai egi gas ende
Io Qenu intoubar ne sarau e abar qamb inimbigor end in me iet igoun.

In qininingau qomon qi eng in gugum mogirt wab wuguminei. Ne wurimurimar qamb qiyo a Qenu qob eng in bo biiges qamb qiyo ende me at igoun. Ue. In Qenu magqurt qib igo ne qob apand eng dibes qomurune munon gugum mom imbig ne ininou sarau eng gor imbigar qamb.
Ne qob uber in dibes qamb igoun eng munon qei me igun qamb obounor eng mom umb uburubour.
Aibigau wuri banambansier end qob uber me igub ne wonou begen gor me gab igour. Begen eng Munon inubersiau tari Qenu iitari qiribiten igo eng.

In ininomi ebet end qob suab me qib igoun, ue. In ete at qamb igoun: ‘munon inubersiau tari Yisas wo ininou Munon Barai, Yisas wonou qob qamar eng in weregi in aninou sarau munon igoun,’ ende qamb igoun.

Qoan Qenu ete qamarei: ‘Itum igama wobon end begen igoriner.’ Qamar end Qenu wonou begen eng der init begent igama in misir uber igo. Begen eng ete: Qenu wonou begen eng Yisast yab di iua igo eng in imbig igoun.
End in munangit eng mi uber ger ai egi erobon igo gas ende. Mi uber qiribiten init igo eng Qenu wonou mi tetemi munon gugum imbigar qamb, in munon mi ue.
Ginam gugum qib in qugurau eng gab igoun ego qugurau eng me inbumai igo. Mi irou in misir ba songesi igo, ego in nasi me wogub igoun.
Munon irou iningaramb qamb intoar arir igour ego Qenu me inbagi igo. Iningaramb arir igour ego in me umb igoun.
Qenen in Yisas mumun togor qib igoun. End Yisas bo der bugab bebereg igo eng gor in git goan end dibeneriner.
In Yisas wonou sarau ebet igoun end in qenen igom igoun. Munon iningaramari umun eng Yisas wonou git goan eng in git goan bieriner end dibeneriba.
End in umau werei end sarau ebet igoun. Ne an igomot igamau werei end igoumon.
End Qenu qob ete igo: ‘Ye Qenut mom oabig ne wonou qob dibes quraum.’ Ende igo end ne in gor Yisast oabig ne wonou qob dibes qamb igoun.
In mom imbig igoun. Qenu Yisas ininou munon aib menima der bugamor gas ende in gor der bugomboun. Bugab an in nob erogori irab wo nob igoruboun.
Mi eng gagar gugum an uber igoarar qamb. Ende abari Qenu wo imusi-imusi munon wurimusia gab munon irou wot uberet unum sig-sig mom ba ereri igorubour.
4:16-5:10 Oau apand burab mi git end qoat igoun
In end misir igub Qenu wonou sarau end me iet igoun. Git apand, in git goan eng boruburiba. Ego ininou misir eng misir bubun-bubun init iger der igo.
In qugurau see gab igoun eng mi aib ue, qen piten igo bo qand uburiba. Ubura qen geret Qenu ginamt qenen mismisir igoruboun. Qenu ginamt qenen uber igoruboun eng see quguraget igoun eng wotanamimba.
In see magqurt asi mi gab igoun end misir me igoun. Ue. In asi magqurt mi me gab igoun end qoot qamb igoun. Mi mag qurt gab igoun eng qen pitent igoriba. A mi me gab igoun eng qenen mom igoriba.
